Microblock metadata, header, and size limits for PoH shred packing.

# Purpose
This header defines the data layout used for microblocks and entry batches in the pack path. It declares `fd_entry_batch_meta_t` for slot and tick metadata, and `fd_entry_batch_header_t` for the PoH hash, hash count delta, and transaction count. The file also defines size limits such as `MAX_MICROBLOCK_SZ`, `MAX_TXN_PER_MICROBLOCK`, and `FD_POH_SHRED_MTU` so the code can fit microblock data into the expected transport size. A static assertion checks that the computed shred size stays within `USHORT_MAX`.
